name: heredoc two
command:
.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
root = Path('mutants')
meta = [p for p in root.rglob('*.meta') if not any(part.startswith('.') for part in p.relative_to(root).parts)]
data = {k: v for p in meta for k, v in json.loads(p.read_text())['exit_code_by_key'].items()}
survivors = sorted(k for k, v in data.items() if v == 0)
print(f'{len(meta)} meta files; {len(data)} mutants; {len(survivors)} survivors')
print('\n'.join(survivors))
PY
